handler_scan.scope: 70-method direct-store scan plus fresh zero-fill and all23 DFM controls

name_rules.direct_cancel: No edited name, no OK validation and no Project.TagName dependency.
name_rules.duplicate_name_comparison: ASCII-only UpperCase, excluding the current object identity only.
name_rules.omitted_name: Full current TagName programmatically loaded; no32-unit clipping or acceptance length check.
name_rules.project_tag_comparison: Exact UTF-16 equality after Trim, only on acceptance.

platform_contract.rule: The user-entry limit does not truncate existing text or text loaded using WM_SETTEXT.
platform_contract.verification: Official documentation, composed with pinned Delphi calls; no Windows execution.

projection_boundary.explicit_name_scope: Up to32 UTF-16 units; does not reproduce editing a preloaded over-limit string through arbitrary keystrokes.
projection_boundary.full_preflight_and_one_owning_save: Owned transaction policy; original per-dialog storage exceptions and partial prefixes are not replayed.
projection_boundary.manager_notifications: TagName after-change may schedule a1ms full sort; native list ordering/timers/messages are not emulated.
projection_boundary.omitted_name_win32_rule: Pinned WM_SETTEXT/EM_LIMITTEXT calls composed with cited Microsoft semantics.
projection_boundary.same_name_noop: Owned projection can omit redundant writes/saves after successful validation.
